responsibility: This definition module declares the Logitech-compatible legacy date/time API for GNU Modula-2. It defines the packed Time record format used by old MS-DOS-style code, along with procedures to fetch the current time, compare or zero Time values, convert them to a fixed textual representation, and provide a compatibility SetTime entry point.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface half of TimeDate: it publishes the packed Time record layout and the exported Logitech-compatible procedures, while the same-stem .mod file provides their executable implementation.
